title: OpenZeppelin AccessControl DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE
detects: Role-based admin. Presence of hasRole indicates a role system, where privileges are held per-role rather than by a single owner.
knownFalseNegative: hasRole requires you to already know which address to ask about, so it cannot enumerate role holders from a single call. Renouncing Ownable while retaining a MINTER_ROLE is a real and common pattern, and an Ownable-only reader will miss it entirely.
rationale: Role systems are how modern tokens hold privileges. They are invisible to owner()-only detection, which is precisely how 'renounced ownership' becomes security theatre.
